name: Sellto Application for WooCommerce
author: amirmansory

sections.description:
Sellto Application for WooCommerce adds an admin page named «اپلیکیشن سلتو» with a QR code that encodes only the public Sellto web app URL:

https://app.sellto.ir/

This plugin does not create Application Passwords, magic links, or any remote administrative access to your WordPress site.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6+
  • WooCommerce (declared via the Requires Plugins header)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sellto-application-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen (WooCommerce must be installed and active)
  3. Open اپلیکیشن سلتو in the WordPress admin menu
  4. Scan the QR code to open https://app.sellto.ir/
sections.faq:
Does this plugin give Sellto remote access to my site?

No. The QR code contains only the public URL https://app.sellto.ir/ . No site credentials, Application Passwords, or connection payloads are generated.

Is the QR code safe to share?

Yes. It only opens the public Sellto web app URL.
